summary: One coordinated maintenance-window release: the 10 November pins plus Digital Tontine and VentureWorks. No CI, deployment, migration, seed reset, account creation, or portal activation happens when this manifest is committed.

hard_gates.preflight: Not run on Contabo; verify live compose project labels/ports/network, SSH credentials, disk capacity, HTTPS issuer and current container/image digests.
hard_gates.source_ci: Exact merged SHAs (including the Tontine PR #43 merge commit) must be on origin/main; build images and record matching immutable SHA tags/digests.
hard_gates.security: Independent Identity, tenant isolation, grant expiry/revocation, privileged worker and financial mock-mode review required before change window.
hard_gates.backups: Protected pre-change snapshots AND independently verified isolated restores of existing Commerce, shared demo Identity, Tontine, VentureWorks and each modified product database; retain current images.
hard_gates.migration: Run Commerce schema migration 125 with approved schema-owner migrator after backup and before new Commerce API; validate RLS and retained rows. Never auto-rollback SQL.
hard_gates.reset: Demo-only Commerce --reset only after backup and explicit data-reset approval; it rewrites seeded products and clears demo POS/cash activity. No production reset.
hard_gates.accounts: QA/partner accounts require confirmed recipient identities and operator-only credential storage; do not commit or print passwords.
hard_gates.activation: Test local health then live HTTPS, OIDC, EN/FR, persona switching, no-access, role/tenant separation, fake-money and rollback; publish portal links last.
hard_gates.approval: Release owner and authorized host operator must approve exact SHA/digests and evidence before any deploy.

existing_workflow_constraint: The contabo-five-demo-release workflow, batch-release.manifest.json and build-staged-demo-images.sh are superseded and refuse to run; they pin stale SHAs. Do not dispatch them for this release.
kit_repin_note: ads-identity and ads-portal stay pinned at 119eb340 as in the 10 November package. VentureWorks private visitors, the ventureworks-web and tontine-web no-access return and the VentureWorks portal destination ship in the kit PR that adds this file; re-pin both kit entries to that PR's merge commit in a reviewed revision before relying on them live.
acceptance_check: deploy/contabo-demo/release-acceptance.sh (read-only; run on the host before opening each product)
